topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The young scholar's plight reminds me of the time poor Elsie’s calf was accused of trampling the village garden. It was a misunderstanding, of course. Just as it seems here, with this lad. To take another’s words as your own is a grave sin, but one might do it out of haste or fear, much like how a spooked horse might run wild. We must look at his heart, not just the act. May the saints guide him, for it’s in forgiveness and understanding that the soil of our community is nourished, ready for the next sowing.
